text:
Dana: FYI eu-north is showing repeated p95 bumps tied to cross-az egress backpressure between rack7 and rack11 since 02:10UTC. Looks like routing thrash + one dedicated tenant hammering egress.
Vik: I'm on it. Initial graphs: `nic_tx_queue_len` oscillating on both racks, `route_retries` up, and allocator logs show a sequence of handoffs that failed fast due to affinity constraints.
Morgan: Are we seeing the usual dedicated-pool suppression of auto-throttle?
InfraBot: [alert] cross-az-egress-thrash@eu-north racks=[rack7,rack11] duration=55s severity=medium auto_action=none reason=dedicated-pool-affinity
Dana: Yes. Tenant `gen-video-ded` pinned to a dedicated slice with az anti-affinity set. Handoffs backfired because scheduler refused cross-az placement for warm pool. That caused repeated retries and amplified routing churn.
Vik: Quick mitigation: create a local ephemeral cushion in the same AZ (rack11-hot) and move the tenant there with `--preserve-kv` and `--allow-az-relax` flag so we avoid cross-az routing. Also attach egress shaping to the tenant to stop queue thrash.
Morgan: We should only relax az rules as a last resort. Suggest adding a temporary console prompt to explain cost/availability tradeoffs when we do `--allow-az-relax`. 
Dana: Running handoff: `allocator move-tenant --tenant=gen-video-ded --to=hot-rack11 --preserve-kv --allow-az-relax --note "egress cushion"`
Vik: Allocator: handoff accepted; warming KV on hot-rack11. Applying egress profile `cushion-300mbit` and local NIC cgroup.
Dana: After move p95 on racks dropped from 480ms -> 90ms. route_retries normalized and allocator retry storms stopped.
InfraBot: action_log: applied egress_shaper(cushion-300mbit) on hot-rack11; allowed az-relax for tenant gen-video-ded.
Morgan: Cost note: moving a dedicated tenant with allow-az-relax burns emergency cushion credits and may increase cross-az egress billing if we later need to replicate state. AccountingBot: Estimated immediate delta: +0.7 GPU-hrs, potential cross-az egress up to 4GB, est cost +$1.10 so far.
Vik: For long-term: propose 1) scheduler policy `graceful-az-relax` that will only relax affinity for a limited window and record billing annotation, 2) console UI to show "impact if relaxed" before handoff, 3) per-tenant toggle to allow infra-driven transient az relax.
Dana: Also we need a guardrail to prevent allocator from retrying cross-az handoffs repeatedly. Add a backoff: if handoff fails twice due to affinity, escalate suggested mitigation instead of retrying.
Morgan: Add metric: `allocator_handoff_retries_by_reason{affinity}` and alert when retries > 3 in 5m. Create ticket to add retry backoff + billing annotation.
InfraBot: Created ticket INFRA-7782 to implement `graceful-az-relax` policy, backoff, and console annotations.
Vik: Owner confirmed gen-video-ded changed sampling concurrency in a deploy earlier today (no tenant-side rate limit). We'll coordinate with the tenant to add client pacing.
Dana: Keeping cushion in place for 40m, will revert when stable. If cross-az become necessary in future, console should warn owners and show cost delta.
Morgan: Agreed. Also recommend adding a small egress-credit bucket for dedicated tenants for emergency auto-cushioning to avoid manual billing surprises. Add to INFRA-7782.
AccountingBot: Noted: please tag events with `emergency_cushion=true` so billing can reconcile.
Dana: Thanks team. Closing loop unless we see a new spike :thumbsup:
